en.dr-ali-peiravi: 28-74 (The author of the book narrated) my father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’d ibn Abdullah quoted on the authority of Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi, on the authority of Ali ibn Muyyasir, on the authority of Abi Zayd al-Maleki that he had heard Abul Hassan Al-Ridha (s) say, “No one but a donkey would reject honoring and respect.”
The Imam (s) was referring to good scent and a comfortable couch for resting on.
